about: Skill trigger prompts. Each prompt is written the way a user would ask, not copied from a description. expect lists the skills that count as a correct first pick; an empty list means no marketing skill should fire. kind: direct (names the task), indirect (describes the problem without the usual keywords), near-miss (sits close to a neighbouring skill), none (not a marketing task).
